description: This is a simple Flappy Bird clone built with HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. The game allows players to control a bird that must navigate through pipes by tapping the screen or pressing a key to flap its wings.
readme:
# Flappy-Bird
This is a simple Flappy Bird clone built with HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. The game allows players to control a bird that must navigate through pipes by tapping the screen or pressing a key to flap its wings.
